abstract: A total of 468 patients were evaluated using a high-resolution scanner with a high-frequency transducer. Scrotal calcifications were diagnosed by sonographic criteria in 22 patients. Size, number, arrangement, and especially location (testicular or extratesticular) were precisely determined. Calcifications, located within testicular parenchyma, particularly if multiple and grouped, were considered highly suspicious for malignancy, and surgery was mandatory. Based on these sonographic features, 9 patients underwent surgery with pathological examination. In all, calcifications were confirmed and found in 4 necrotic germ-cell tumors, in a germ-cell tumor scar but with intratubular occult seminoma, in 1 epidermoid testicular cyst, in 1 tuberculous epididymo-orchitis, in 1 granulomatous orchitis, and at last, in 1 ruptured testis with an old hematoma. In the 13 remaining patients, calcification was usually defined as solitary, large, and extratesticular by sonography and considered benign. No changes were seen in follow-up examinations.
abstract_ja: 高周波数の探触子を備えた高分解能スキャナーを用い、468例の患者を評価した。超音波学的基準により陰嚢内石灰化は22例で診断された。石灰化の大きさ、個数、配列、特に部位（精巣内か精巣外か）を正確に決定した。精巣実質内、特に多発性で集簇する石灰化は悪性腫瘍の可能性が高く、手術が必要と考えられた。これらの超音波所見に基づき、9例が病理学的検査を伴う手術を受けた。石灰化が確認されたのは、壊死性の胚細胞腫瘍4例、胚細胞腫瘍瘢痕で管内潜在性セミノーマを伴う1例、類表皮嚢胞1例、結核性精巣上体精巣炎1例、肉芽腫性精巣炎1例、そして古い血腫を伴う精巣破裂1例であった。残りの13例では、石灰化は通常、孤立性・大型・精巣外として超音波で定義され、良性と考えられた。フォローアップ検査では変化は見られなかった。
